notes.title: Tit Tap Tingle 1.1 - New (Free) Minigame, Steam Leaderboards, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Tit Tap Tingle v1.1[/h1]
A new minigame is coming to Tit Tap Tingle for free, with exciting chiptune music, leaderboards, and new achievements!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Minigames[/h3]
We've released our first minigame as a free part of the Tit Tap Tingle experience. It's called "Tit Tap Stomp", and allows you to control and help Misaki evade the thirsty men that are trying to snatch her away. She can stomp on them with her feet, which may be reminiscent of a famous plumber, but her jumping abilities are far greater than you may expect. Try your best and get the highest combo and score you can! 

[h3]Steam Leaderboard[/h3]
Stomping your way to victory? Well, let's see how you compare with others around the world! Compete to get the highest score and greatest honor by being the top stomper on Tit Tap Tingle's new pixel-based minigame, Tit Tap Stomp!

[h3]4 New Achievements[/h3]
We have 4 brand new achievements included in this free content update, so please aim to... achieve them!

[h3]2 New OST Tracks[/h3]
We have 2 brand new themes, and both of them are chiptune tracks! We hope you enjoy them! 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Input lag should be reduced by a bit.
- Small bug fixes made to the Event system.
- Options are now fully verified to be working.

[h3]How to Report Bugs[/h3]
Find a bug in the game that you want... or need fixed?! We're online and we're waiting! Please post on our forums so that we can tackle the issue. Screenshots, videos, and an overview of what OS you're using (Windows or Mac) will help speed things up a lot. Thank you!

[h3]Please Send Us Suggestions![/h3]
If you have any suggestions for future minigames, gameplay feature changes or improvements that can be made, or anything along those lines, please please send us a message or post on the forums. Our ears are open, and we want to make your experience on Chikubijima the best that it can be!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Released! Bug Fixes
notes.content:
List of bugs fixed and improvements made (7/25/2020):
[list]
[*] No more bugs or freezing during the second part of Event 7s in the Gallery,
[*] Achievements should now properly unlock if you were to watch an event in a Gallery due to missing one from a prior bug in version 1.0. 
[/list]

We will strive to fix any problems and make any requested improvements as more people play our game! If you have any suggestions, please either post them in the Community Hub or send us a longer, more detailed email at touchme@tittaptingle.com.

Enjoy your stay at Chikubijima!
